GRR.headline: Heavy rain likely Saturday, 1-2+ inches across much of the area

areas.label: Heavy rain, 1-2+ inches
areas.quote: High confidence in rainfall north of 1" across much of the area, with NBM probabilities of > 2" north of 60% in spots.

areas.label: Showers, isolated storms south of I-96
areas.quote: The best coverage will be south, however rain showers are possible into this morning, especially south of I96.

areas.label: LIFR, patchy fog AZO/BTL
areas.quote: Most sites are IFR, with LIFR at AZO/BTL with patchy fog across those terminals as well.

areas.label: Gusts 22+ kt, Small Craft possible
areas.quote: Increasing winds will support gusts aoa 22 knots, though the easterly flow does favor the better waves remaining over the open waters.

DTX.headline: Heavy rain likely Saturday; 1 inch+ possible, highest north

areas.label: Widespread heavy rain Saturday
areas.quote:
Widespread showers return in earnest Saturday into Saturday night.
  Rainfall totals in excess of half an inch are likely, with the
  potential for 1 inch or more.

areas.label: Slight risk excessive rainfall
areas.quote:
EPS ensemble data highlights 
an interquartile range of 24 hr QPF of .8 to 1.5 inches with higher 
values in across the northern cwa including the Tri Cities.

areas.label: NE/E gusts 20-30 kt Lake Huron
areas.quote:
A moderate gradient, supporting NE/E gusts 20-30kts, lingers behind 
the low Sunday into the new work week as the area holds between the 
stalled boundary over the Ohio Valley and high pressure over 
northern Ontario.

MQT.headline: Rain likely Friday–Saturday, heaviest possible in Menominee County

areas.label: Locally over an inch of rain possible
areas.quote: There is a slight chance (~20-40%) of amounts exceeding an inch, mostly limited to Menominee County south of US-2.

areas.label: NE winds 20-30 kt, waves 2-3 ft
areas.quote: Friday and Saturday, low pressure passing by to the south combined with a high to the north will result in prolonged northeasterly flow into the western arm of Lake Superior, with winds increasing locally to 20-30 kt and waves of 2-3 feet.

areas.label: LIFR fog near Ironwood
areas.quote:
The only exception will be some persistent LIFR fog at IWD 
early this morning, but that should improve by mid-morning.
